header: Named editions with their price and their scope
lead: A list, not a table: the scope of a licence is a sentence about who may use it and where, and a sentence does not fit a cell.
note: The note holds the terms common to every edition — tax, maintenance, transferability, governing law.

tiers.title: The edition name is a heading
tiers.text: Each tier is an item of the band, so it takes the third heading level.

tiers.title: The price is pinned to the end edge
tiers.text: It is the one column a reader scans straight down, so the figures share a width.

tiers.title: The scope is prose
tiers.text: Workstations, addresses, redistribution rights — everything a cell would have truncated.

tiers.title: On a phone the row stacks
tiers.text: A price two lines away from the name it belongs to is a price attached to nothing.
